title: Maths and Economics Teacher
pay: MPR1 to UPR5: £33,245 to £51,558 (SECAT pay scale, 1% above STPCD)
summary: Join a thriving, heavily oversubscribed secondary academy in the SECAT Trust, teaching KS3 to KS5.
body:
## The position

Bright Futures Recruitment is looking for a dedicated and resilient maths teacher to join a thriving co-educational secondary academy in Shoeburyness. It's an exciting opportunity for a passionate educator who is committed to helping students reach their full potential and make a real impact on their learning journey.

## About the school

A large, vibrant and diverse secondary school within the SECAT Trust, with an excellent reputation for a warm, supportive environment in which to work and learn. Highly regarded by local families, it is very popular and heavily oversubscribed.

The school takes great pride in its values and its people. Its dedication to high-quality learning, effective teaching and exemplary behaviour is consistently recognised, and its latest Ofsted report (2024) rated it Good.

## The role

Teaching Key Stages 3, 4 and 5. The post would suit experienced colleagues and newly qualified teachers alike, who would be well supported by an effective ECT programme.

## What's on offer

- Teachers' Pension Scheme
- Staff benefits scheme
- Health and wellbeing support
- Subsidised lunch
- Discounted wraparound school club
